name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.server.QChatServerMemberInfoActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user selects a server member. It shows the member's profile and roles; authorized users can edit a nickname, change role membership, or remove the member from the server.
disableEffect: Users cannot view or manage a selected member's server details through the built-in QChat screen.
